categories.name: 1 Finance Macroeconomic Index
categories.description: A composite index built from high-frequency indicators that tracks India's economic phase and has historically anticipated GDP growth.

categories.name: Subindices
categories.description: Gain comprehensive insights into the Indian economy through our broad set of subindices

categories.name: Economic Growth
categories.description: Track India's economic growth with real-time indicators including real and nominal GDP, GVA across sectors, IIP, manufacturing and services PMI, and capacity utilisation.

categories.name: Inflation
categories.description: Track India's inflation with real-time indicators including CPI and WPI inflation, core and food inflation, crude oil prices, gold and silver prices, and money supply.

categories.name: Monetary Policy & Interest Rates
categories.description: Track India's monetary policy and interest rates with real-time indicators including the repo rate, CRR, SLR, lending rates, deposit rates, real interest rates and RBI liquidity.

categories.name: Fixed Income
categories.description: Track India's fixed income markets with real-time indicators including the G-sec yield curve, 10Y G-sec yield, G-sec and corporate bond yield spreads, and credit spreads.

categories.name: Banking & Credit
categories.description: Track India's banking and credit with real-time indicators including bank credit growth by sector, personal loans, aggregate bank deposits and the credit-deposit ratio.

categories.name: Equity Markets
categories.description: Track India's equity markets with real-time indicators including Nifty indices, sectoral PE ratios, FPI and DII flows, mutual fund AUM and primary market issuances.

categories.name: Trade & Currency
categories.description: Track India's trade and currency with real-time indicators including the trade balance, exports, imports, current account deficit, USD/INR, forex reserves and FDI flows.

categories.name: Government Finances
categories.description: Track India's government finances with real-time indicators including the fiscal deficit, debt to GDP ratio, GST collections, gross tax revenue and capital expenditure.

categories.name: Agriculture
categories.description: Track India's agriculture with real-time indicators including monsoon rainfall, kharif and rabi sowing progress, foodgrain stocks, reservoir levels and fertiliser sales.

categories.name: Consumption & Demand
categories.description: Track India's consumption and demand with real-time indicators including vehicle sales, rail freight, air and port traffic, e-toll collections, steel, cement and energy demand.

categories.name: Jobs & Employment
categories.description: Track India's jobs and employment with real-time indicators including EPFO payroll additions, MGNREGA work demand and the unemployment rate.

categories.name: Other Indicators
categories.description: Track more of India's high-frequency economic indicators, including CPI inflation across urban and rural India and essential commodity prices.

categories.name: Markets & Calendar
categories.description: Global equity valuations and the calendar of scheduled Indian data releases.
